notes: The text prints only one Clinical Laboratory Scientist award: 'Certificate of Achievement: College of the Canyons Clinical Laboratory Scientist Lecture Program', Units Required: 36.5. It lists 12 courses (CLS-200 through CLS-208 and CLS-211, 212, 213).

That certificate does not match the named award. The named award is the 'Accelerated Lecture Program', a certificate of 16 to fewer than 30 units. Its closed list of six courses (CLS 201, 202, 203, 204, 206, 208) totals 18 units. So no blocks were recorded for it.

The 36.5-unit certificate prints one Certificate Student Learning Outcome: 'Students will be able to evaluate the body of knowledge for technical competencies required of entry-level clinical laboratory scientists (CLS).' It was not recorded because it belongs to that other certificate. A reviewer should check whether the Accelerated program shares it.
The Accelerated program's requirements may be on another catalog page or in an addendum. A reviewer should locate the correct source.
